tips.text: Keep your clan small and skip extra barracks until the research is done; costs scale with clan tier.
Start the 72-hour research timers early and farm Mutagen Samples while they run.
Research Torid and Acrid anyway; they are required even though you never use them.
Start all five Mutagen Mass crafts early; each holds a foundry slot for 12 hours.
Players call it underwhelming and get it for Mastery; the grind is a short, low-stakes dojo errand.
